heading: Allow the microphone
introduction: Chrome asks for permission only once. This way your voice is recorded together with the tab audio. This tab opens by itself when the permission is missing.
waitingHelp: The prompt appears at the top left, next to the address bar. Choose your computer's real microphone, not a “virtual” one.
grantedHelp: You can now record with your voice. You can change the microphone in the panel.
grantedDevice: You can now record with your voice. We chose “{{device}}”; you can change it in the panel.
closing: This tab closes by itself in <time>{{seconds}}</time> s and you return to the panel.
stepIcon: Click the lock or microphone icon to the left of the address.
stepReturn: Come back to this page and click the button.
settingsHelp: If you do not see the icon, open chrome://settings/content/microphone and look for “Sauri” in the list.
systemHelp: If macOS blocks Chrome, you will also see the message “Permission denied by system”: fix it in System Settings → Privacy → Microphone.
deviceError: Could not access the microphone. Check that it is connected and try again.
closeError: Could not close this tab. You can close it and go back to the panel.
